original_title: Hundreds rally in Paris against Iran’s crackdown on protesters

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Hundreds of protesters gathered in Paris to oppose Iran's crackdown, but no direct threat to assets, cargo, aviation, or personnel has been reported.
